hacked.label: Hacked account
hacked.reply:
Hello, {user}

I can see there was activity from your account involving links that should not have been posted on the server. If you would like to proceed with an unban request, please provide a screenshot showing that you have recently changed your Discord password. The screenshot should include the date and time, along with any other relevant information that helps verify the change.

I also strongly recommend enabling two-factor authentication (2FA) on your account for additional security. If you'd like, you may include proof that 2FA has been enabled as well.

As a general reminder, account security is your responsibility. Future incidents involving a compromised account may result in a longer or permanent ban, and appeals may be denied if reasonable steps have not been taken to secure the account.
hacked.note: Hacked account case {date} - requested proof of password change, recommended 2FA - awaiting user response
